title: Mersal
desc: Maaran, a doctor, is falsely arrested for the murder of his colleague, Dr Arjun Zachariah. He soon discovers that the real culprit is a lookalike who aims to expose corruption in the medical industry.

title: Ee Parakkum Thalika
desc: Unni, a bus owner, tries several ways to improve the condition of his bus, which is named after his late father. Things take a turn when the daughter of a powerful politician enters his life.

title: Mr. Butler
desc: Gopalakrishnan, a chef, escapes from his village to a city when his marriage gets ruined. Later, he falls in love with Radhika, but his happiness is short-lived as his past returns to haunt him.

title: Patturumaal
desc: Contestants try to win the hearts of the judges by singing traditional Mappilapattu, which are Muslim folklore songs sung in the local Mappila dialect of Malayalam laced with Arabic.
